visual_facts_checked.result: Supported except the minor four-player shape descriptor above.
facts: Page6 two-board map joins balanced boards bottom-to-bottom, with printed Oceans at opposite outer corners. Page6 three-board illustration is triangular. Page7 four-board illustration uses two rows of two boards in the standard arrangement. One board per Spirit and the use of balanced sides are consistent.
Page6 Fear-deck graphic has three groups of three cards separated by Terror II and III in the order stated. Invader-deck sidebar shows 3 Stage I, 4 Stage II, 5 Stage III.

Page7 displays separate Minor/Major decks and discards, each Spirit personal hand/play/discard areas, a distinct Spirit on each board, and remaining disks on track spaces with initial leftmost benefits uncovered.
Page7 Invader board shows initial Explore card in Build, deck in Explore, and empty Ravage. Board setup icons correspond to Invader/Dahan/Blight population, and Oceans are printed peripheral areas.
Upper example has Sacred Site source icon before Range1 and ANY in Target Land; its effects include Destroy1 Dahan. The Dahan effect icon is not an implicit requirement to target a Dahan land.
Lower example has Range1 and Dahan silhouette in the Target Land box, making Dahan a target requirement. Source icons belong in the Range box independently of target icons.
Printed explanation confirms do-as-much-as-possible applies to effects, not extra targeting constraints; using a Power is all-or-nothing apart from consistently treating Elements as fewer.
Element legend visibly distinguishes Sun, Moon, Fire, Air, Water, Earth, Plant and Animal; the thresholds do not spend them, and Instead replaces preceding effects.

candidate_sections: Actions: Gather, Push and other movement
facts: Presence spiral and Sacred Site stacked-presence icon are distinct; Sacred Site legend says 2 or more Presence. Range0 means land with own Presence; terrain-Presence icon plus Range1 means origin must be Mountain Presence; Sacred Site plus Range2 requires a Sacred Site origin. +3 over arrow is a range increase.
Explorer/Town slash example Push2 allows two Explorers, one of each, or two Towns: one total allowance, not two of each. Town/City slash land requirement allows at least one of either or both.

Target reference distinguishes any one land, Coastal touching printed Ocean, Inland not touching Ocean, with/without Invaders, with Dahan, with/without Blight, Mountain-or-Wetland, any Spirit and another Spirit (solo exception).

Track icons show highest uncovered Energy number, highest uncovered Card Plays number, Reclaim One returning one discard each Spirit Phase, and a bonus Element for as long as uncovered. No additive numeric-track income/plays is indicated.
Fast red bird/Slow blue turtle timing, printed unit health/damage/Fear values, and turn-order reference support the candidate. Living FAQ referral is visibly printed at the bottom.
